feature_name: Object Lifecycle Management custom time conditions
summary: Custom time conditions let lifecycle rules act based on a custom time set on objects.
extended_definition: Custom time conditions let lifecycle rules act based on a custom time set on objects.

If it's zero, the object version will become eligible for lifecycle action as soon as it becomes custom. custom time before datetime.date (Optional) Date object parsed from RFC3339 valid date, apply rule action to items whose custom time is before this date.

If it's zero, the object version will become eligible for lifecycle action as soon as it becomes non current. noncurrent time before datetime.date (Optional) Date object parsed from RFC3339 valid date, apply rule action to items whose non current time is before this date.
